title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a scratch computation of p-adic valuations of factorials. It supports the divided-power (PD) material of the 1976 IHÉS lecture.

(1) Legendre's formula, boxed: v_p(n!) = (n − s_p(n))/(p−1). Here s_p(n) (Grothendieck's "chif_p n") is the sum of the base-p digits of n. Writing n = Σ n_α p^α, he proves it by n − s_p(n) = Σ n_α(p^α − 1). Dividing by p−1 gives Σ n_α(1 + p + … + p^{α−1}), which is the classical count.

(2) Second boxed formula: v_p(p^n/n!) = n − (n − s_p(n))/(p−1) = (s_p(n) + n(p−2))/(p−1).
- This is the valuation of γ_n(p) = p^n/n!, the divided powers of p in Z_p.
- It shows γ_n(p) ∈ pZ_p for n ≥ 1, so the ideal pZ_p carries a PD structure.
- For p odd the valuation tends to infinity with n.
- For p = 2 it equals s_2(n). This is 1 at every n = 2^k, so the PD structure on 2Z_2 is not topologically PD-nilpotent. This is the familiar special behaviour of p = 2 in crystalline/Dieudonné theory.

(3) A started line "v_p((n+1)!) =" is left blank.

(4) Below the rule he computes v_p((p^{r+1})! / ((p^r)!^p · p!)). It equals (p^{r+1}−1)/(p−1) − p(p^r−1)/(p−1) − 1 = (p−1)/(p−1) − 1 = 0.
- This number is the coefficient c in γ_p(γ_{p^r}(x)) = c · γ_{p^{r+1}}(x), which follows from the PD axiom γ_m(γ_n(x)) = (mn)!/(m!(n!)^m) γ_{mn}(x).
- So c is a p-adic unit. Hence γ_{p^{r+1}}(x) is a unit times the iterated γ_p applied to x, r+1 times.
- Consequently a PD structure over Z_(p) is determined by γ_p alone, and the divided-power algebra is generated by the γ_{p^r}(x).
- Together with the previous page (binomial coefficients c_{μ,ν} prime to p when μ+ν = p^r − 1, i.e. Kummer/Lucas with no carries), these are the standard elementary lemmas for PD algebras and the PD de Rham complex in characteristic p.

The next page switches to universal vector extensions and tori (13.4.x), i.e. the Dieudonné/crystal side of the lecture.
